#4141. New gum disease treatment kills bad bacteria while sparing the good

Researchers in Japan have developed a promising new treatment for gum disease that kills harmful bacteria while leaving beneficial microbes unharmed. Unlike conventional approaches that can eliminate both good and bad bacteria, the new therapy is designed to target specific microbes responsible for damaging gums and the bone that supports teeth.

Developed by scientists at Nagoya University, the treatment combines antibodies obtained from egg yolks with near-infrared light. Early experiments in human cell cultures and mice suggest that it could offer a more precise way to combat periodontitis, a serious form of gum disease that can eventually lead to tooth loss. The findings were published in the Journal of Translational Medicine.

Why Conventional Gum Disease Treatments Can Cause Problems

The human mouth contains a complex community of microorganisms, many of which play important roles in maintaining oral health. Problems can arise when harmful bacteria multiply and disturb this delicate balance.

One particularly troublesome species is Porphyromonas gingivalis (P. gingivalis), which scientists classify as a keystone pathogen. This means it can have an outsized influence on the surrounding microbial community, even when it is not especially abundant. By promoting inflammation and disrupting the normal balance of oral bacteria, it can contribute to the destruction of the bone that holds teeth in place.

Treating periodontitis often involves eliminating the bacteria responsible for the infection. However, some existing antimicrobial treatments do not distinguish between harmful organisms and microbes that help maintain a healthy mouth.

"Current treatments for periodontitis, including antibiotics and antimicrobial photodynamic therapy (aPDT), eliminate both pathogenic and beneficial oral bacteria," said Kazuhide Sato, one of the corresponding authors and a lecturer at Nagoya University. "These approaches often disrupt the entire oral microbial ecosystem and can also release lipopolysaccharide (LPS), an endotoxin that may exacerbate inflammation."

Scientists Adapt Cancer Therapy to Target Gum Disease Bacteria

To overcome these limitations, the Nagoya University team turned to a technology originally designed to treat cancer. Known as near-infrared photoimmunotherapy, it uses antibodies linked to a light-sensitive dye to recognize specific targets. Once the compound attaches to its intended target, exposure to near-infrared light activates the dye and produces a damaging effect.

The researchers adapted this strategy to attack P. gingivalis without unnecessarily disturbing other oral bacteria. Their approach relies on IgY, a type of antibody collected from the egg yolks of hens that have been immunized against the pathogen.

Egg yolk antibodies offer a practical advantage because they can be produced in large quantities at relatively low cost. This could make them an attractive option for developing targeted treatments that are affordable and scalable.

The resulting technology, called near-infrared photo-antibacterial targeting therapy (NIR-PAT²), was developed by researchers at Nagoya University Graduate School of Medicine. The team included first author Hiroshi Maruyama, Professor Hideharu Hibi, and corresponding authors Sato and Kiyoshi Sakai.

To determine whether the treatment could destroy harmful bacteria while protecting healthy tissue, the researchers tested it in human cell cultures and mice. They also compared its effects with those of conventional antimicrobial therapies.

Light-Activated Antibodies Destroy Harmful Bacteria

Laboratory experiments showed that the antibody and dye combination attached specifically to P. gingivalis. Other bacterial species and healthy human gum cells were left unaffected.

When the researchers illuminated the targeted bacteria with near-infrared light, the activated dye damaged their outer membranes, ultimately killing them.

Microscopic examination revealed an important difference between this technique and conventional antimicrobial light therapy. Bacteria exposed to the new treatment developed tiny openings in their membranes but largely maintained their overall shape. By contrast, conventional antimicrobial photodynamic therapy caused the bacteria to break apart completely.

The distinction matters because destroying bacterial cells can release substances that contribute to inflammation. Preserving the overall structure of the targeted bacteria, even after killing them, could help limit this unwanted effect.

The researchers also examined how the treatments affected healthy human gum cells. Their targeted therapy caused no detectable harm to these cells, while conventional antimicrobial photodynamic therapy produced cellular damage and slowed healing.

The team next investigated whether these laboratory findings would translate into meaningful improvements in gum disease.

In mice with periodontitis, the experimental therapy significantly reduced the loss of alveolar bone, the part of the jawbone that surrounds and supports teeth. Preventing this type of bone deterioration is especially important because advanced periodontitis can loosen teeth and eventually cause them to fall out.

Analysis of the animals' saliva revealed another encouraging result. The treatment reduced P. gingivalis while preserving beneficial Streptococcus bacteria, helping maintain a healthier balance of microorganisms in the mouth.

Conventional antibiotics and antimicrobial photodynamic therapy, on the other hand, eliminated both harmful and beneficial bacteria in the experiments, causing broader disruption to the oral microbial community.

"Results demonstrated that, unlike antibiotics or standard light therapy, this approach selectively removes the primary pathogenic species while preserving the remainder of the oral bacterial community," Sato said.

Together, the findings suggest that targeting individual disease-causing bacteria could help control gum disease while avoiding some of the unintended consequences of broader antimicrobial treatments.

AI Could Help Develop More Precise Gum Disease Treatments

Although the early results are promising, the researchers recognize that periodontitis is a complex disease involving multiple bacterial species. Eliminating P. gingivalis alone may not be sufficient to treat every case.

To address this challenge, the team plans to use artificial intelligence (AI) to examine publicly available information about oral bacteria. By identifying other important microorganisms and studying how different species interact, they hope to uncover additional targets for future therapies.

The researchers also see potential implications beyond oral health. Periodontitis has been linked to several other medical conditions, including rheumatoid arthritis and diabetes.

Understanding the relationships between oral bacteria and these conditions could eventually help scientists identify which patients are most likely to benefit from specific treatments. AI analysis may play a role in making those decisions and guiding the development of more personalized approaches to gum disease.

For now, the therapy remains experimental, with its effectiveness demonstrated in laboratory studies and mice rather than human clinical trials. However, the findings point toward a possible future in which treating gum disease means selectively removing harmful bacteria instead of disrupting the entire microbial community that helps keep the mouth healthy.

Materials provided by Nagoya University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.

#4140. Update: You Can Preload Grand Theft Auto VI On PS5 and Xbox Today, And You Should Because It's Massive

Rockstar Games revealed last week that players can preload Grand Theft Auto VI on their console of choice the following week, and that time has arrived. The studio released a blog post today to announce that you can preload GTA VI on PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro, Xbox Series X, and Xbox Series S. If you're excited about the game, you will probably want to go ahead and do this because it will take up a whopping 212 GB of space on your drives – make the room now so you don't hit this roadblock next week when the game goes live on Thursday, November 19.

The blog post also details performance on PlayStation and Xbox consoles, and you can read more about what to expect here.

We're just over two weeks away from the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI, which recently graced the cover of Game Informer. Ahead of its November 19 launch, Rockstar Games has announced that digital preloading for GTA VI will begin next week on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.

More specifically, preloading on Xbox Series X/S will begin Tuesday, November 10, at 12 a.m. GMT (4 p.m. PT/7 p.m. ET on November 9), and on PS5 at midnight local time in your time zone. Although Rockstar isn't producing physical discs of GTA VI, you can still buy a physical box at retail, which includes a download code for the game. The studio says, "Code-in-box versions for both consoles should be available from retailers beginning November 12."

The preload file will require 212 GB on your device, so make sure you have the space before you start the download. You can find more details about this process here.

Elsewhere in today's GTA VI news, Rockstar has revealed that on November 19, it will add an official printable GTA VI cover art poster and a map of Leonida as a free digital download to the game's official site. However, a double-sided physical version of this poster will be made available shortly after the launch of GTA VI from the Rockstar Store. It will only cost $0.99 on its own, or come free with any other purchase from the store.

GTA VI launches November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S.

For more, check out the song "Pusher" from the game's original score, then check out the GTA VI launch trailer. After that, check out this exclusive story about how GTA VI features over 170 animal species and another about how the game features tropical storms and hurricanes.

What are you most excited to experience in Grand Theft Auto VI? Let us know in the comments below!

#4139. Definitive Apple Arcade games list - Every available title so far

Every game, every genre, all of the Apple Arcade essentials you need to know about

If you get spoiled for choice when browsing through the Apple Arcade library, we can't blame you. There are well over 100 games in the incredible service, and you can spend hundreds of hours playing through them all. So the question is, where is best to spend your time? What is Apple Arcade? Apple Arcade is a subscription service that you can use on all of your Apple devices, including your iPhone, iPad, Apple TV or Mac. It allows you to play games from a list that includes over 180 games at the moment, and your progress is transferred between devices, meaning you can continue where you left off. It's really handy, and the Apple Arcade games list gets expanded often, so you'll always have new games to play.

No matter what kind of game you're looking for, you'll find it on these pages. Here we've put together a comprehensive Apple Arcade games list of every title currently released, in the order of release, with the genres included so you can find exactly what you want.

Apple Arcade games list 2026 Just take a look below, and you'll find everything you need to know about every game that's on the Apple Arcade games list of 2026, sorted by genre and release date (latest first).

Hipster Whale's blocky Frogger-like is running down a different path in Crossy Road Rush. Now, you'll dash across an island, hopping from place to place while trying to avoid colliding with walls and other obstacles.

Yes, the beloved survival crafting game is now available on Apple Arcade, complete with Dead Cells and Palworld crossover content.

Get a healthy dose of bullet heaven in River City Survivors, which sees you slaying zombies while picking up equipment and synergies along the way.

Indulge in some classic arcade games like Pac-Man, Space Invaders, Galaga and a whole lot more.

Naruto: Ultimate Ninja Storm+ (Bandai Namco)

With controller support and dozens of characters, you can enjoy battles and stories from Naruto.

Ever wanted to start your own cult? Well, now you have to. After being saved by an ominous stranger, you'll have to repay your debt by gathering him new and loyal followers. It won't be easy, though. You'll need to battle off hordes of enemies and take down other cult leaders to help boost your own.

Ah, Worms. For people of a certain age, it was a staple of their childhoods. Creating your little worm troop and then sending them into battle against your pals was always a joy. Now a new version is available on Apple Arcade, bringing those same turn-based tactics to the palm of your hand.

Everyone's favourite grumpy avians are back with a slight twist. Rather than flinging themselves at their porcine foes, this time you'll take down the piggies in a brick breaker-style setup. Okay, so there's still an element of flinging.

Much like Triband's previous efforts, What the Clash? is another wacky fun time that sees you competing – either solo or co-op – in numerous party games.

SpaceInvaders InfinityGene Evo (Taito Corporation)

SpaceInvaders InfinityGene Evo is, as the name suggests, an evolved version of the classic arcade shooter. Sporting the gameplay we all know and love, it throws in a few twists to help breathe new life into this familiar setup.

Katamari Damacy Rolling Live (Bandai Namco)

Everything you need to know is pretty much in the title. Katamari Damacy sees you rolling a stick ball that grows bigger as more and more items become stuck to it.

Pac-Man continues to be relevant in the gaming world and 256+ allows you to enjoy even more dot-munching action.

Drive Ahead! Carcade (Dodreams Fairytale Company)

Ever have the urge to drive recklessly? Well, here you can live out those bizarre fantasies with no real-world consequences! In Cardcade, the goal is to bonk your opponent in the head once. Yep, that's all it takes, which means it's not as simple as it sounds in practice.

Arkanoid vs Space Invaders+ (Taito Corporation)

Arkanoid vs Space Invaders+ combines the two classic games in one, tasking you with defending the Earth by deflecting bullets back at your foes.

Poncle's excellent Vampire Survivors is now available through Apple Arcade. If you're unfamiliar, it's a bullet heaven game where your character automatically flings a barrage of projectiles at your enemies, leaving you only worrying about walking away from any incoming danger.

One of the most iconic mobile games is back, albeit with a slight twist. In Temple Run: Legends, there are levels to complete rather than the endless dash we're used to. On each, there are three stars to earn on the one-hundred-plus levels, so your swiping skills need to be on point.

Battle your way to the top of the tower where success lies in how good your timing is and whether or not you pick the right move.

Tomb of the Mask is an arcade action game that sees you exploring a tomb.

A Slight Chance of Sawblades+ (Yong Kian Chin)

In a strange and dangerous turn of events, it's raining saw blades. To survive the deadly storm, you must dodge, jump and backflip away from the tools dropping from the sky.

Beast is a 3v3 shooter that sees you battling for the honour of your home planet. During each match, you can switch between pet and beast forms, making use of the different abilities and weapons each brings.

Everyone's favourite speed hedgehog comes to Apple Arcade to do battle with his old foe Eggman. Choosing one of six playable characters, you will dash, climb, and fly your way through each of the stages.

As the name heavily suggests, Downwell sees you making your way down a well in search of treasure. To defend yourself, you are equipped with a pair of Gunboots to vanquish the threats that lurk within the well.

Taken on the role of James Bond in this top-down action adventure that draws inspiration from the last 60 years of the storied hero.

Junkworld is a tower defence where you take charge of the Scavenger clan and lead them to victory in a series of battle, making use of towers, special units and gadgets.

A fishing game with a difference, Ridiculous Fishing EX sees you using guns, chainsaws, and even toasters as you head into the depths in search of a big catch.

TMNT Splintered Fate (Viacom International)

Join everyone's favourite turtle quartet in this brand-new roguelike action game. Splinter has been captured and it's up to you to save him. You can play as any of the four Turtles, each with distinct abilities and powers alongside teaming up with three other players.

Time Locker is a shooter with a minimalist but colourful aesthetic. In it, you control the speed of time using your finger and must avoid obstacles and enemy attacks. The Apple Arcade version comes with new exclusive enemies.

Temple Run is one of mobile gaming's all-time classics. If, somehow, you're unfamiliar, it sees you running, jumping, and sliding through temples, collecting riches as you go.

Snake.io+ is a battle royale that sees you slithering around and eating pellets in a bid to become the last serpent standing. By cutting up other snakes, you can make them explode into pellets, which you'll want to gobble up to increase your size.

PPKP stands for Punch Punch Kick Punch, which gives you a rough idea of what to expect. You will attempt to save a city from deadly monsters by honing your martial arts skills so you can unleash a devastating combo to defeat them.

Navigate a world covered in random everyday objects by playing as a man in a pot wielding a hammer. It's as frustrating as it is odd, but ultimately rewarding if you manage to scale the mountain that lies ahead of you.

As the title suggests, in this driving/platforming action game, you play as a car made of bouncy jelly. With this in mind and armed with several abilities, the aim is simple. Navigate each level and find the exit.

Motion Twins' excellent roguelike can now be enjoyed as part of your Apple Arcade subscription. It sees you playing as a failed experiment, setting off to explore wildly different biomes.

Barry Streakfries has returned. Once more, he will need to battle through the laboratory and attempt to put an end to the experiments being carried out there.

The latest entry in the popular Subway Surfers series is an Apple Arcade exclusive. In Subway Surfers Tag, you will head to numerous city locations and skate, grind, and tag your way to a high score. The Guard will be there to make things more tricky though, so be ready to evade him.

Pick your favourite Sonic the Hedgehog character before running, jumping and dashing through plenty of levels. Alongside regular running levels, you will also face off against Eggman and Zac in special Boss Racing stages.

Alto's Adventure is a mobile classic that sees players embarking on a snowboarding adventure where they'll grind over rooftops and leap across perilous chasms. The remastered version includes new challenges for players to tackle and several new set pieces.

Disney Melee Mania is a MOBA that features a variety of characters from the franchise's many popular films. Each match lasts five minutes, making it great for playing on the go, and there are currently 12 Champions to choose from, including Buzz Lightyear and Wreck-It Ralph.

Oddmar sees the titular character embarking on a journey to prove himself worthy of a place in Valhalla. Along the way, he will collect magically imbued weapons and shields that will help him smite down his foes.

Get a blast of nostalgia with Galaga Wars+, which sees you taking control of the iconic spaceships and gunning down waves and waves of enemies.

Play as a cute bird who has always dreamed of flying. Run down hills to use them as jumps to soar through the air, if only for a moment.

The extremely popular Crossy Road is now available on Apple Arcade, allowing you to collect all the characters and the numerous stages as part of your subscription.

The popular endless runner is now available on Apple Arcade. Fly through several levels using a bullet-powered jetpack as Barry Steakfries looks to put an end to a group of scientists who are up to no good.

Alto's Odyssey: The Lost City is the definitive version of the gorgeous endless runner. It features an all-new biome for players to explore alongside additional challenges to beat.

The classic slingshot action game returns with new birds, pigs and challenges. There's also a brand new game mode to enjoy where players are tasked with stopping the Eagles from wreaking havoc on the island.

Leo's Fortune is a platformer where you will hunt down a fiend who rudely stole your gold. The game has received a lot of praise since it first launched, and now you can play it as part of your Apple Arcade subscription.

A retro-fueled underwater adventure where you can create your own soundtrack.

Compete with players from around the world in hyper-casual competitive mini-games or throw a Super Mega Mini Party with friends!

This is an action driving game where you'll be swerving around corners, collecting new powers, and shooting down choppers, all while zipping past bullets.

Bleak Sword is a dark fantasy action game tasking players to struggle across compact, cursed diorama battlefields.

The floor is lava, so you'd best stay off it any way you can.

Build your way to the top in this lighthearted, team-action brawler where anything can happen.

Creatures of the Deep+ (Infinite Dreams Inc)

Fancy going fishing? That's exactly what you can do in Creatures of the Deep, heading out in your little boat in search of an impressive catch. But be aware that disturbing shadows are lurking in the deep...

The third main instalment in the Zelda-like series takes place 1000 years after Oceanhorn 2, bringing you a completely new adventure. You'll have to battle through the Shadow Sea, which doesn't sound like a pleasant place for a cruise.

Head down to Bikini Bottom for some side-scrolling action with everyone's favourite sponge. He's on a mission to find his missing fry cook station while Plankton joins him because his inventions have also been stolen.

Return to Monkey Island+ (Terrible Toybox)

This one's for the point-and-click adventure fans out there, particularly those who have previously enjoyed Ron Gilbert's work.

In this adventure, you'll form a team of Ubisoft's critters and use their special powers to vanquish your foes.

Tamagotchi Adventure Kingdom (Bandai Namco Entertainment)

In this colourful game, your goal is to restore the titular kingdom to its former glory by building and decorating your wilderness camp before inviting your Tamagotchi pals to enjoy it with you.

From the creators of What the Golf? Comes What the Car?, a silly racing game where you can roll, jump, fly and even sneeze your way to the finish line. You play as a car, but rather than having wheels, you have a pair of legs. It's as fun as it is absurd.

Very Little Nightmares is a puzzle adventure game where you are tasked with escaping The Nest, a giant maze littered with traps.

Enjoy the incredibly atmospheric Limbo as part of your Apple Arcade subscription. You play as a young boy who is looking for his sister and must traverse a deadly world to find her by solving puzzles and jumping over perilous gaps.

Old Man's Journey+ is an emotional adventure that focuses on life's precious moments and plans that need to be changed.

The critically acclaimed adventure game Monument Valley 2 is now available through Apple Arcade. If you're unfamiliar, it sees players guiding a mother and her child through a world filled with magical architecture.

The developers of Old Man's Journey and ELOH has returned with a game that looks to emulate the way gibbons swing from tree to tree. Meanwhile, the narrative tackles topics such as deforestation, poaching, and climate change.

Wylde Flowers is a life and farming sim, but with magical spells thrown in for good measure. You take on the role of Tara, who arrives on the island to help her grandma with the family farm. It promises to provide a whole adventure as you explore magical realms, beaches and forests.

Raw Fury's Metroidvania Dandara: Trials of Fear can now be enjoyed as part of your Apple Arcade subscription. It sees you battling to save the world of Salt from an imminent collapse.

In Star Wars: Castaways, you will explore a mysterious planet that has been abandoned for a long time. Throughout the game, you will make new friends and battle against some imposing enemies.

In Monument Valley, you will manipulate impossible architecture and guide a silent princess through a stunningly beautiful world.

A modern twist on the trials and tribulations of the road to Oregon, this official successor to the global phenomenon will immerse players in exhilarating journeys ranging from the historically accurate to the completely wild.

A beautiful adventure game that explores how everyone can make a difference in the world even with the smallest of actions.

All of You is a cute, purely visual, accessible, family-friendly puzzle adventure with unique gameplay. Play and pause time in every part of the level to unveil the right path for the main character.

The Last Campfire is an adventure, a story of a lost ember trapped in a puzzling place, searching for meaning and a way home.

The ground starts shaking, light bulbs are breaking - and something rather unusual is happening right behind the walls of your very room. Equipped with nothing but wit and courage, you slowly descend into a world inhabited by avian folk and seemingly deadly furniture monsters.

Sequel to the classic adventure game Beneath a Steel Sky.

Beyond Blue takes you into the near future, where you’ll have the opportunity to explore the mysteries of our ocean through the eyes of Mirai, a deep-sea explorer and scientist.

Live the life of a Sasquatch and do regular, everyday Sasquatch stuff like: Sneak around campsites. Disguise yourself in human clothing.

FreeCell Solitaire: Card Game+ (MobilityWare)

Pretty much as it says on the tin. FreeCell Solitaire lets you enjoy the classic card game in as straightforward a way as possible. No bells and whistles needed here.

If ruining long-standing friendships is your idea of fun, then you might want to give Uno: Arcade Edition a try. It's the classic card game we all love to get frustrated by with a few intriguing twists to the existing formula.

Dip into some of your favourite tabletop card games with Crazy Eights. It has numerous modes to enjoy that mix up the rules, helping keep things fresh.

Texas Hold'em Poker: Pokerist+ (KamaGames)

No real surprises here, simply a way to play poker online, pitting your skills against other players to win big.

LocalThunk's Balatro exploded in popularity when it released early in 2024. The simple concept of creating strong poker hands combined with deckbuilding, tactics and even some maths has led to it being viewed as one of the best games of the year. And now you can play it on your phone!

Monster Train+ (Good Shepherd Entertainment)

If you haven't played this excellent roguelike deckbuilder and happen to have an Apple Arcade subscription, you're now in luck. Monster Train sees you riding on the titular locomotive on a journey to restore a frozen hell to its former glory. Well, if hell is ever glorious, I suppose.

This one's fairly self-explanatory, you can play the card game 21. You have unlimited chips too, so you can play against the dealer to your heart's content.

Pocket Card Jockey: Ride On is a game that combines solitaire and horse racing. The game previously released on Nintendo 3DS but is now available as part of your Apple Arcade subscription.

Learn to play Gin Rummy using tutorials and perfect your skills against bots offline. The aim is simple: you want to create the best hand possible by picking up or drawing one card at a time.

Spider Solitaire: Card Game+ (MobilityWare)

Enjoy the classic card game Spider Solitaire as part of your Apple Arcade subscription.

Now you can enjoy the classic card game Hearts as part of your Apple Arcade subscription. You can test your skills against AI that adapts to your playstyle to make sure you stay on your toes.

Experience the classic card game with a plethora of beautiful deck designs, daily challenges and explore your competitive nature by trying to climb the leaderboards.

The addictive game you’ve been playing on your computer for years now goes wherever you do. Whether you know it as Patience, Klondike, or just Solitaire, this popular game is one of the best games around.

Like its footwear namesake — Flipflop Solitaire is unrestrictive, creating a new game for fans of spider, klondike and other traditional Solitaires.

If the idea of adorable cat-like creatures appeals to you, then Pusheens is worth checking out. You'll gather a veritable army of them before popping them in their new home, which you can also customise.

Unpacking is a Zen puzzler that sees you moving house several times over a period of time. It's entirely designed for relaxing, so you don't have to worry about timers, scores or any of that business. Just kick back and enjoy.

A bunch of evil monsters and villains need serving, and it's up to you to fulfil their orders.

The most famous and most popular endless runner is now available on Apple Arcade. Race along those tracks and grab coins to your heart's content without fear of any adverts of in-app purchases required.

Cleaning might not sound fun on the surface, but trust me, you'll love it in PowerWash Simulator. Armed with a powerful jet washer, you'll have to blast the muck off house, vehicles and other objects until they're spick and span. It's incredibly satisfying.

Piffle+ sees you slinging adorable cats around levels to break all the blocks. It's a simple premise, but trickier to do in practice.

Suika Game is deceptively simple. All you have to do is get two of the same fruit to come into contact with one another so they merge to form a larger fruit, with the ultimate goal being to create a watermelon. It sounds straightforward and perhaps a little dull, but before you know it, an hour's passed and you'll be itching to make more watermelons.

Helix Jump tasks you with guiding your ball through a series of twisted towers using physics-based movement.

There are few games as synonymous with mobile as Doodle Jump, and now this classic is available on Apple Arcade. The concept is simple, yet inherently compulsive. You can waste many hours on this one.

Another entry in Outfit7's popular franchises, Talking Tom Blast Park sees the titular hero embarking on an adventure to stop Rakoonz.

Smash Hit+ sees you smash through an ethereal dimension in time with music. It promises to be a meditative experience despite the destruction you're leaving in your wake.

While Furista is a push as a pun, I'm happy for it count as a fan of felines. In this game, you adopt cats before matching your customers with them to make their visit to your cafe as fluffy and enjoyable as possible.

Collect and nurture fish so they become what they were always destined to be... Dragons! That's right. Zen Koi Pro+ is a relaxing experience that follows the Asian myth that koi can become dragons with enough care and attention.

The popular casual management sim is now part of Apple Arcade. It follows Emily as she looks to progress her career while preparing to become a parent.

If you've ever wanted to build your own farm, this might be the game for you. Farmside allows you to place plots, plant crops and harvest them. Beyond that, you can raise animals and spend time designing your farm's layout.

2017's App Store Game of the Year is now available through Apple Arcade. The aim is simple, you have to search for the titular hidden folks across numerous levels. There are over 300 in total with 32 hand-drawn areas to investigate.

Another of MobilityWare's card games is now available on Apple Arcade. This time you can play Spades as much as you'd like. The aim is to work with a partner to try and out-bid your opponents while trying to reach 250 points first.

Now you can enjoy the classic card game Hearts as part of your Apple Arcade subscription. You can test your skills against AI that adapts to your playstyle to make sure you stay on your toes.

Experience the classic card game with a plethora of beautiful deck designs, daily challenges and explore your competitive nature by trying to climb the leaderboards.

The addictive game you’ve been playing on your computer for years now goes wherever you do. Whether you know it as Patience, Klondike, or just Solitaire, this popular game is one of the best games around.

Like its footwear namesake — Flipflop Solitaire is unrestrictive, creating a new game for fans of spider, klondike and other traditional Solitaire games.

Blast off into outer space with an intergalactic indie rock band in the latest instalment in the popular Reigns series.

Bring your friends and see how far you can get in this endless spinning tower of arcade fun! Keep climbing as high as you can. Every run is different.

Would you believe me if I told you that there's a puzzler about folding paper that's incredibly beautiful? If you're an origami fan, most likely. But to anyone else, it'll be a pleasant surprise in Kami 2+.

Block Blast is one of those simple yet endlessly engaging puzzlers. All you have to do is match blocks on an 8-by-8 grid and then enjoy them all exploding. However, it's never quite that simple, constantly asking you to think deeper than you might expect.

Art of Fauna: Cosy Puzzles+ (Klemens Strasser)

If you love nature and puzzles, then Art of Fauna is perfect for you. It sees you essentially putting together some beautiful artwork, with each accompanied by some text about the depicted animal.

Water Sort Puzzle: Get Color+ (Tripledot Studios)

A colourful and relaxing puzzler that will keep you occupied for hours and hours.

It's a bunch of puzzles you can do every day, right? Pretty much! There is a mix of word puzzles and brain teasers for you to tackle each day to keep your mind strong.

Fancy yourself as an artist? Draw It gives you the opportunity to prove it, tasking you with sketching out a visual depiction of a word before the time runs out.

Perchang is a physics-based puzzler that takes you through a series of colour environments. It's wacky fun that's all narrated by popular British comedian, James Acaster.

Flow Free is as simple as puzzlers can get. However, don't expect it to be easy. Connect up colours might sound straightforward, but it becomes very tricky over time.

If you love pretty colours and solving puzzles, then I Love Hue Too+ is for you. It sees you rearranging mosaic tiles to make beautiful creations.

The Battle Cats now have a spin-off! Now you can fling them at blocky towers. It might sound straightforward, but making them all tumble to the ground isn't as easy as you might think.

Lost in Play is a story about a brother and sister trying to find their way home. To do so, you will need to solve a series of puzzles alongside chatting with some whimsical creatures.

No great surprises here, Words of Wonder: Search+ is... a word search! That's right. It pretty much does exactly what it says on the tin. So if hunting for a list of words is your jam, you're well catered to here.

Sumi Sumi: Matching Puzzle+ (Imagineer Co. Ltd)

Sumi Sumi is a puzzler that tasks you with matching popular characters from San-X together while enjoying all the beautiful animations that accompany doing so.

What do you get if you mix stickers with jigsaws? puffies. That's what! Designed to be a calming experience, it tasks you with open sticker packs before piecing together the various puzzles.

Put your word skills to the test with Zynga's Arcade edition of the popular puzzler Boggle.

If you're a fan of Wheel of Fortune and fans of daily puzzles, this game is exactly what you're looking. Each day, you will have to solve one, with plenty of variety promising to keep it fresh every time.

Enjoy some match-3 puzzling with a delightful cast of colourful characters.

Super Monsters Ate My Condo brings some whacky match-3 to the table. This new and updated version offers improved visuals but, thankfully, leaves the gameplay we all know and love untouched.

The popular tile-matching puzzler comes to Apple Arcade. It sees you popping the titular Puyos across several different game modes.

Words in Progress sees you combining letters to create words. You can either find how long you can survive in Endless Mode or test your word crafting prowess against other players.

Cornsweeper promises to be a meditative puzzler where the aim is to avoid explosions going off. It draws heavy inspiration from Minesweeper, as you might have guessed by the name!

Puzzle & Dragons Story (GungHo Online Entertainment)

The popular series brings its blend of match-3 puzzling and RPG elements to Apple Arcade. By matching colours, you will battle your way through deadly dungeons while recruiting new companions to help you in the fight.

Knotwords is a word puzzler that brings together elements of Sudoku and crosswords.

Train your brain by engaging with a series of crossword-style games that see you looking to create words.

Om Nom is back in the third instalment in the popular puzzler series. The aim is to reunite Nibble Nom and Om Nom on each stage by engaging with the various mechanics that the game has to offer.

finity. is a matching game with three simple rules to follow. But that doesn't mean it's going to be easy as you attempt to climb the leaderboards.

Nekograms is an adorable puzzler where the goal is to help every cat you encounter fall asleep. To do this, you have to move the felines and cushions around until they've found the perfect place to curl into a ball and nap.

Bold Moves+ is a puzzler where you match tiles to solve a series of word puzzles. It offers a mixture of daily and weekly events alongside plenty of levels to work through.

Disney SpellStruck is a word puzzler that takes place on The Isles of Tiles. It tasks you with solving a bunch of crossword-like games with popular Disney and Pixar characters like Mickey Mouse, Stitch, and Tinkerbell.

Make your way through a series of matching puzzle games while working on your own tropical island. Along the way, you can get help from beloved Disney and Pixar characters, with each bringing special power-ups.

Doctor Who: An Unlikely Heist (Tilting: Point)

If you enjoy the popular BBC sci-fi series and puzzlers, then Doctor Who: An Unlikely Heist might be for you. It sees you finding hidden objects and solving a series of puzzles.

Human: Fall Flat+ is now available on Apple Arcade. It's a jokey physics-based platformer that can be enjoyed on your own or with four pals.

If the title didn't make it clear enough, Castle Crumble is all about toppling strongholds. Using a mixture of explosives and spells, you will travel through different time periods destroying castles as you go.

Illustrated is a puzzler where the solutions lie in the images in front of you as well as the story. When you beat each story, each illustration is unveiled in full colour.

As the name implies, stitch. is a game all about embroidery. The aim is to fill in each area without leaving any gaps. The game calls them Hoops, and they come in different shapes and sizes, ranging from landscapes to plants to animals.

Garden Tails: Match and Grow is a relaxing puzzler for fans of wildlife and nature. It sees you building your own garden by completing match-3 puzzles to unlock new flowers, bushes and critters.

Jigsaw Puzzle by MobilityWare+ (MobilityWare)

Jigsaw Puzzle is exactly what it says on the tin. You can sit back, relax, and solve a series of jigsaw puzzles. There are 26,000 of them in total from well-known brands, including Disney and Hasbro.

Prune is a beautiful game that serves as a love letter to nature, and specifically trees. It sees you growing and shaping your tree with simple swipe controls. The goal is to guide them towards the sunlight while avoiding the many dangers the world presents.

Moonshot is a physics-based puzzler that tasks you with guiding Moon Pi – a moon who has become separated from Earth – back home. It uses drag and release mechanics as you launch Moon Pi past the gravity fields of other planets. There are also other obstacles to dodge, such as black holes and aliens.

As the title suggests, Bridge Constructor tests players' bridge assembly prowess across 40 levels. You will need to make sure they can withstand constant use from cars and other heavy vehicles like trucks and super-heavy tank trucks.

Splitter Critters is a cute puzzler where the aim is to guide the little creatures safely back to their spaceship. To do this you will be able to split the world into different pieces to create a path the critters can traverse.

Temple Run: Puzzle Adventure is a match-3 take on the well-known franchise. You will look to create powerful combs to make special pieces that allow you to become a Temple Champion.

Zookeeper World is a match-3 puzzler that allows players to create their own zoo. The more levels they beat, the more animals, plants and accessories they'll unlock to use in their zoo.

Checkers, your new free checker game (also known as Draughts), will entertain you for hours! It’s challenging with 5 different levels, yet relaxing and beautiful with 8 different designs.

When the tranquillity of suburban life is threatened by a huge building site, Simon and his cat mobilise the neighbours to help restore the mysterious wasteland before the diggers destroy it all.

A 3-D colour-matching game that sees players being tasked with toppling a series of mysterious towers that have appeared in the kingdom

A quiet, sombre adventure best experienced with a loved one.

Eat loads of pills and pellets while chasing ghosts with your friends!

Embark on an epic hand-animated adventure from Zach Gage, Pendleton Ward, and Choice Provisions. Cast powerful spells, slay fantastic monsters, discover ancient secrets, and ultimately save the world — just by picking up the right cards.

Dear Reader lets you curl up and play your favourite books, turning classic literature into clever word puzzles. Unscramble passages from famous books, unlock unique puzzles and add new books to your library.

Grindstone is a puzzle-meets-action hybrid that will see you slashing through dozens of meaningless monsters on a path of destruction and carnage. Beautiful.

Patterned is a unique puzzle game that immerses you in the beauty and joy of seamless, repeating patterns.

Tint lets you solve puzzles by painting. Mix watercolours to match the colour of the origami - all at a soothing pace and in the comfort of your own garden studio.

Where Cards Fall is a slice-of-life story where you build houses of cards to bring formative memories to life. Create pathways through dreamlike spatial puzzles to navigate the insecurities and emotions of high school and beyond.

Lego Hill Climb Adventures brings a mixture of exploration, racing, and upgrading to the table, all presented with everyone's favourite building blocks.

Lego Friends Heartlake Rush+ (StoryToys Limited)

Hop in various Lego vehicles and race through Heartlake City in high-octane action that sees you dodging traffic and roadblocks on your journey to be the fastest pile of bricks on the course.

Enjoy some Hot Wheels-branded racing action in this game with all the loop the loops you could ever hope for.

The classic game is now available on Apple Arcade. You play as Bill, an aspiring uphill racer as he drives a series of unique vehicles up hills and over obstacles.

Horizon Chase 2 is a fast-paced arcade racer with gameplay inspired by the genre's best entries from the '90s.

Gear.Club Stradale is all about supercars. You and your friends can start your own club in Tuscany, Italy and drive expensive cars from manufacturers like Bugatti, Porsche and McLaren.

Race with your favourite characters from several beloved cartoons, such as American Dad!, Family Guy, King of the Hill and Solar Opposite.

Enjoy Gameloft's popular racing game without any microtransactions. There are over 250 licensed vehicles from the likes of Ferrari, Ducati, Lamborghini and many more.

Race on mobile with Sonic and his friends.

Dungeon Clawler is a roguelike deckbuilder that uses the claw machine as a way to grab various items. It's a fun twist on the usual formula, and this claw actually grabs things, unlike those you find in UK arcades.

Hyke: Northerine Light(s) (Akatsuki Games)

If you like your RPGs doused in pixelated goodness, then you might want to check out Hyke. Playing as the titular character, you set out on a journey to find your missing mother. Along the way, Hyke's witch powers will come in handy against the threats you face.

Black Salt Games' excellent Dredge has now moored on Apple Arcade. If you're unfamiliar, it's essentially a relaxing fishing sim, until it suddenly isn't. You see, Eldritch nightmares are lurking in the depths that will do their best to destroy your humble vessel.

Final Fantasy IV: The After Years+ (Square Enix)

Ever wondered what happened after Final Fantasy IV? Well, in The After Years, you can play out that tale. This version is a full 3D remake too, so it looks better than ever.

Final Fantasy IV (3D Remake) + (Square Enix)

You can now play the 1991 classic on your iPhone or iPad with additional features compared to the original.

Stardew Valley is a game that needs no introduction if you've previously indulged in its cosy world of breeding animals and growing crops. If you are unfamiliar, it's an open-ended RPG where you can not only manage a farm but also settle down and make a family while participating in community events.

The quintessential deck-building roguelike is now available on Apple Arcade. Slay the Spire has remained at the top of this sub-genre because it's still comfortably one of the best.

My Town Home – Family Games+ (My Town Games)

Explore a doll's house with over six different rooms to explore. There are multiple members of the family to meet, each with a different pet.

Episode XOXO promises a constantly growing library of interactive stories where your choices will influence the narrative.

First launched in 2014, Battleheart Legacy is now available on Apple Arcade. You can choose from several typical fantasy classes before heading into battle to vanquish nasty beasties.

In this crafting-based RPG, you will take on the role of Flux Dabes, a galactic trucker who needs to recover his missing packages after becoming stranded on an alien planet.

Embark on an adventure where you will collect Monsties and form bonds with them. This revamped version of the game includes graphical improvements and a better user interface.

Fantasian is an exciting, new RPG set against a spectacular backdrop made from over 150 handmade dioramas that blend physical environments and 3D characters.

Engage in an epic storyline for control of the mysterious Nexus and the fate of the universe as players step into the role of their favourite Star Trek heroes and villains in the hit franchise's official team-based RPG.

Join the Crystal Gems for the ultimate mobile RPG. It’s time to Unleash the Light!

Unleash the Light features an original story co-written by Rebecca Sugar, and voiceover from the Steven Universe cast and special guest star Christine Baranski

A young Knight faces an impossible challenge, as Warlock Mesmeroth has returned with a formidable Dark Army. Will our hero be able to unite the Owrus, Gillfolk, and men in a fight for the fate of the world?

While food is mainly for eating, that doesn't mean it can't look good too. In Food Stylist, that's your job: make every dish look as good as it tastes.

As the name implies, Pocket City 2 sees you creating your own city. But it's not all stuffy business meetings and financials. You can also participate in street races and basketball challenges. It's a fun place, evidently.

Outfit7's popular virtual pet sim is now on Apple Arcade! You'll have to look after your new pal, making sure he's fed and happy.

If running a coffee empire is something you've always dreamed of, then now is your chance to make it a reality. Well, virtually, anyway. And it's not just one place either; you can expand your business across the world, taking over Tokyo, Paris, Berlin, and Amsterdam. Watch out, Starbucks.

Who doesn't like pizza? Anyone who answers that question with “Me” simply cannot be trusted. I'm sure we all agree. In Good Pizza, Great Pizza, you get to run your own business, serving customers one of the greatest foods ever created.

Before houses became incredibly hard to afford, the dream was building your own home with your partner. Pocket Love!+ allows you to make it a virtual reality in a cute and cosy package.

Doraemon Dorayaki Shop Story+ (Kairosoft)

Running a sweet shop sounds like every kid's dream, and you can make it a reality thanks to Kairosoft.

Join up with Tom, Angela, Hank, Ginger, Ben, and Becca as the beloved group of friends arrive on Apple Arcade.

Anyone who loves theme parks probably has a vision in their head for what their ideal version of one is. In RollerCoaster Tycoon, you can live out that fantasy, building the perfect park for everyone to enjoy.

Pretty much as the title implies, HyperBeard's My Dear Farm sees you creating your own farm. It's a laid-back experience that allows you to decorate your buildings and grow your crops without any of the stresses and strains of real-life agriculture.

A jovial adventure through the oil rush in 19th-century North America. Become an entrepreneur and help grow your business and, subsequently, your town.

Outfit7's virtual pet simulator is now available on Apple Arcade. Chat with the titular feline as you collect different pieces of furniture and other fashionable items. Aside from playing with Tom, you can also enjoy a host of different mini-games.

Construction Simulator 2+ (astragon Entertainment)

As the pretty self-explanatory title implies, Construction Simulator 2 sees you building a construction company while making use of over 40 originally licensed vehicles. This includes companies such as Caterpillar, Liebherr, Palfinger, Bell, Still, Atlas, and Mack Trucks, among others.

Game Dev Story+ allows you to create your own game company, looking to make millions from the development of a best-selling video game.

Lead your favourite NFL team to glory in the latest instalment in EA's long-running series.

Mini Football Legends sees you take charge of a rookie team to turn them into legends, one match at a time.

Sometimes we write these entries, and it feels a little unnecessary when the title says everything you need to know. If you like pool, you'll probably enjoy Ultimate 8 Ball Pool, which promises a realistic experience, both in terms of physics and graphics.

Channel your inner Tony Hawk by pulling off dozens of skateboarding tricks and flips.

Once again, NBA 2K27 is back on Apple Arcade, letting you become a basketball star in MyCareer.

If golf is your sport, then here's the perfect Apple Arcade choice for you. Put your driving and putting skills to the test across several real-world courses, including Pebble Beach Golf Links, Firestone Country Club and Latrobe Country Club.

The fantastic Retro Bowl series is back, now with a new coat of paint. It's the same nostalgia-fuelled football game you already know and love, but now it has official branding from the NFL.

Take the courts in the latest iteration of 2K's beloved basketball game. Enjoy a quick game or dive deep into MyCareer.

One of the best mobile games to release in 2020 is now available on Apple Arcade. In Retro Bowl, you take charge of a team and lead them to victory by progressively upgrading your players and facilities while putting your offence skills to the test on the field.

Much like Retro Boal, Retro Goal mixes together straightforward team management with testing your skills on the pitch.

Ever want to run your own farm? Well now you can, without the inconvenience of having to traipse through mud. Choose from over 100 vehicles and tools to expand your farm and create products to sell at the market.

Hit the slopes in this snow sports game where there are 11 massive open-world mountains to explore.

Think you have what it takes to lead a football team to victory? You can put those skills to the test in Football Manager 2023 Touch, which allows you to tweak everything from the ticket prices to your formation.

Fancy a spot of Ten Pin bowling? Now you can as part of your Apple Arcade subscription. My Bowling 3D+ promises realistic physics, allowing you to play a variety of different shot types. You can adjust your stance, direction and the amount of spin used when taking a shot.

The title is pretty self-explanatory, but Pro Darts 2022+ allows you to enjoy the sport on your phone or tablet. It promises fully textured 3D game environments to provide a more realistic feel alongside a host of custom boards.

As the name implies, Nickelodeon Extreme Tennis sees a roster of characters from numerous shows play against one another to see who's best. You can control SpongeBob, Angelica, Rocko, Garfield and many more.

It's a cartoonish golf simulator with 2 - 4 players involved at the time.

NBA 2K21 puts you on the court with today’s top NBA stars like Damian Lillard, Kevin Durant, Steph Curry, Zion Williamson, and Anthony Davis.

Multiplayer soccer for all of your friends.

A new, fun, fast-paced, cross-platform soccer game for 2020. Sociable Soccer is ultra-flexible and accessible, offering something for everyone.

Put your baseball strategy to the test in live head-to-head matches where you’ll choose the perfect pitch to strike out opponents, or swing for the fences on your way to becoming a champion.

Swing bats and throw balls through the intertwined histories of humankind and cricket in this one-button, physics-driven game.

Capture the heart and soul of street skating in a style that’s all your own. Push to perfect your flow and improve your skills while mastering hundreds of trick combinations.

Golf, but not as you know it. Dozens of stages, and a lot of golfing you wouldn't expect.

There are currently no survival games on Apple Arcade.

Create the greatest empire history has ever seen as the beloved 4x strategy game makes its way onto Apple Arcade.

The fifth instalment of Ironhide's excellent tower defence series is now available as part of Apple Arcade. In it, you team up with former foes to stop an even greater threat, all with the action and humour you'd expect.

The latest entry in the town-builder series promises to be easy to pick up but trickier to master. Of course, you can expect the usual offbeat humour as well.

If you happen to enjoy fashion, romance, celebrity gossip and have a penchant for time management games, this is for you.

A delightful deck-building roguelike where you will battle against monsters and search for loot to prepare for a battle with Lady Luck herself.

Kingdom Two Crowns is a side-scrolling strategy game with a beautiful pixel art aesthetic. You play as a monarch and go about recruiting loyal subjects, building your kingdom and protecting it from danger.

LEGO Star Wars Battles is a real-time multiplayer game that sees players battling against one another in iconic locations from the sci-fi franchise's history.

Legends of Kingdom Rush is a turn-based RPG that promises to deliver tactical depth and a good sense of humour too.

Really Bad Chess is just like chess but with totally random pieces. Try 8 Knights, 4 Bishops, and 3 pawns — why not?

Pick your words wisely! As you play, more tiles rise from the bottom of the screen!

A motorway building adventure that'll have you playing for hours, and getting very frustrated.

Outlanders is a charming town-builder simulation game that lets you play as the leader of a group of regular people building a town together.

In Felicity's Door, you travel through a world of amazing dreams in the only way that makes sense: by completing various rhythm games.

I'll give you one guess for what this one's about. Bingo! It provides your children with plenty of different scenes to colour in alongside various other activities to enjoy, such as drawing and cooking.

Disney Coloring World+ (StoryToys Entertainment)

Cluedo: Hasbro's Mystery Game+ (Marmalade Game)

#4138. Love and Deepspace 5.0 update brings together all five love interests for the first time

Love and Deepspace is getting a big update to celebrate its second anniversary, and there's a lot to dig through.

If you can believe it, Love and Deepspace is almost two-years-old, and Infold Games is celebrating the moment in a few major ways. The Throne of Eros update brings the game up to version 5.0, and it’s one for fans of all love interests.

For one, this is the first time all five of them are brought together. The update is also adding some important new features, alongside anniversary events, and more.

Throne of Eros also doubles as the new Wish Pool, which is the one that has all of the game’s love interests in a single banner. This is a limited-time affair, of course, but it’s not the only thing you should look forward to here.

There’s also the Memory Growth Bonus, another limited-time event that you can take advantage of to grow your Memories. The even bigger news is that you can target your Wishes through the Xspace Echo, which lets you select five Memories to create your own pool from. You can use this to get any Memories you might not have, of course.

On the topic of Memories, you’ll also be able to unlock new second anniversary KV Memories, as part of a Yearly Highlights Event that will let you look back on your own journey with the game over the past year.

On the story and narrative side, Throne of Eros adds two new main stories, with new branches for Xavier, and Rafayel. There’s even a narrative-specific event that will run throughout the anniversary period, through which you can earn two daily outfits for each of the five love interests.

The celebrations also extend to new anniversary content like mail, and video calls. You can purchase a Yearly Pass, and check out some new arrivals at the Lunar Shop.

Beyond the anniversary content, version 5.0 also adds a new feature to the game: Home, which essentially offers a hub to get you directly to interacting with love interests that doesn’t have to do with combat or story.

You can also expect various other quality of life updates that touch on the Journal, Phone Moments Search, Resources Quick Cleanup, and new Tete-a-Tete that should make interacting with all of them more streamlined.

While this is a special banner, you should brush up on how banners work in Love and Deepspace if you’re unfamiliar. As always, it’s never not a good idea to check our Love and Deepspace codes page for some freebies.

#4137. House House Discloses AI Use For 'Under 0.1%' Of Big Walk's Code Following IGF Voting Controversy

Big Walk developer House House has found itself at the center of a controversy over the upcoming Independent Games Festival on March 3, 2027, after a group of its jurors said they would not vote for any game that has used generative AI in any capacity. The jurors' statement does not name House House or Big Walk, but the studio eventually updated its FAQ to explain how it used generative AI for coding after IGF discussions. After vaguely posting on social media, those associated with IGF made clear that a sticking point in the voting process was Big Walk.

Former games journalist and game developer Austin Walker posted the IGF jurors' statement on Bluesky, explaining that voting has been difficult this year due to the "significant increase in the number of submitted games developed with generative AI tools."

"This has set off some fairly intense discussion and disagreement across the judge and jury pools, and at this point there is no universal consensus on what (if anything) is to be done," the statement reads. "The IGF has affirmed that we may cast our votes according to our own tastes and values. But we, as a contingent of IGF jurors, feel that this trend and the games embracing it deserve stronger pushback than a vote in silence."

The statement continues, explaining that not all jurors are on board with the blanket statement, citing reasons including "their ability to safely sign without professional blowback." It continues, "Above all: Our goal is to state solidarity with those who despair over the future of their art, their craft, and their industry – including those who have experimented with these tools, but who now believe they are not in our best interest."

The statement continues with the jurors' beliefs regarding gen-AI, including its negative effects, that any gen-AI used in any process of game development is not okay, noting specifically that "AI-generated code is not an exception to these harms," and more.

"For those reasons, this year we are declining to vote for any game that uses generative AI in any capacity," the statement says. "We urge the IGF to adopt a strong anti-AI policy for future years that disallows games containing any AI-generated work." The statement then includes the names of the IGF jurors who signed it.

Big Walk isn't specifically mentioned within that statement. However, Kyle LeClair, a four-time IGF judge and a juror for the upcoming IGF, tells Aftermath that "it got to the point where the most-discussed game this year almost entirely involved its AI usage, overshadowing pretty much everything else." LeClair says it felt like a boiling point, adding, "Anyhow, strong props to the jurors for taking this stance and putting out this letter as well, even if some people believe that using AI for coding purposes is a more gray area, we're at a point where the amount of AI slop clogging up the indie game scene means having to take hard stances such as this in order to discourage such an amount of recklessness."

Again, no mention of Big Walk. However, game developer Bruno Diaz took to BlueSky to confirm the speculation: that most-discussed game was Big Walk. "Okay, because the cat is out of the f---ing bag, I might as well combat misinformation a bit: 1. The reason IGF judges are aware of the LLM use in the development of Big Walk is through a disclosure shared by House House. 2. This disclosure was required by IGF rules. 3. While some have characterized the LLM usage as just fixing one individual blocking bug, this is a bit inaccurate; the description given by House House mentioned there being several instances, though they did also say it was mostly 'consultative' use and not code gen or agents."

Diaz notes that they believe that distinction is without a difference, adding that "to my knowledge, it is not the case that Big Walk is non-compliant with the former [Steam's AI disclosure requirements]."

"Yes, there was a large discussion about this in internal IGF forums," Diaz said. "Yes, a lot of people said things that I personally think were disingenuous, extremely disappointing, or just (frankly) dumb. No, I have no intention of talking about it in further detail or exposing anyone. [...] Ultimately, it is extremely difficult for a group of over 100 people to keep a secret so I expected this to come out eventually. Shrug emoji. If you think something is reputationally damaging, consider not doing it."

With discussion surrounding Big Walk happening during the IGF discussions, House House updated its FAQ to address, "Was AI used to make Big Walk?" Here's what the FAQ reads, in full:

"In the final stretch of Big Walk’s development, LLMs were used sparingly by House House to help work through difficult technical challenges and bugs. In some cases, snippets from LLM responses were copied as a starting point to be modified into game code—we’d estimate that well under 0.1% of Big Walk’s code had anything to do with this usage, and generative AI was not used in any other context when making the game.

The primary use case for House House’s use of LLMs was to research, via chatbots, issues we encountered with third-party code. If you’re technically-minded, and curious, here’s an example. We needed to cull shadow casters by distance from the camera, but Unity URP only allows culling shadow casters by distance in camera forwards, so shadow casters behind the player were being rendered at an infinite distance. This made our game run 50% slower for around 20 seconds at sunrise and sunset. We researched the problem extensively, and we looked at the URP code ourselves, but we couldn’t find a way. Then, we were able to speak directly to an engineer at Unity, who asked around and ultimately concluded that what we wanted wasn’t possible. Finally, we posed the question to an LLM chatbot. After a few dead ends, it suggested a possible fix, and while we had to modify the suggestion extensively, it worked. This fix represented about 10 lines of code inside URP.

We originally wrote a version of the above disclosure as it was a suggested part of our IGF submission. We have not made any disclosure on Steam as the platform does not request disclosure of code or chatbot usage. We are posting this disclosure as it has become a matter of public interest.

This is not an endorsement of, or argument for, the use of AI tools, however minimal. We have some concern that voluntary disclosures like this might contribute to the normalisation of this technology, or its treatment as “inevitable”. We support the work of those who are trying to limit the harm generative AI is doing to videogames and our world, and apologise that Big Walk’s LLM usage may not meet their standards.

Big Walk was developed without an internal AI usage policy in place, and we consider that lack of policy a failure. We will work to have a more comprehensive policy going forwards."

As you can see, House House did not disclose its use of AI-generated code because "Steam as a platform does not request disclosure of code or chatbot usage." It says it is posting the disclosure now as "it has become a matter of public interest."

House House recently made headlines for choosing not to put Big Walk on Xbox in accordance with the Palestinian-led BDS boycott against Microsoft Games. Earlier this year, it gained widespread critical acclaim for its unique emphasis on cooperative puzzle-solving – you can read more about that in Game Informer's Big Walk review.

#4136. Genshin Impact Version Luna 4 introduces three new playable characters, including the long-awaited Moon Maiden Columbina

The first major Genshin Impact update in 2026 is almost here, bringing characters we've been waiting a while to play, and more besides.

Genshin Impact’s latest Special Program has spilled all the beans on the game’s next major update, Luna 4. The update, which arrives on January 14, kicks off 2026 with several bits of new content, including some previously-teased characters.

Dubbed Traveler on a Winter's Night, Luna 4 introduces three new playable characters, and brings back The Lantern Rite event to celebrate the beginning of the new year.

The first new arrival in Version Luna 4 is Columbina Hyposelenia, the Moon Maiden. Columbina is a 5-Star Hydro Catalyst wielder. Her kit revolves around supporting the squad via Lunar Reactions. She can trigger coordinated Lunar Reaction DMG, even when she’s off the field.

The Moon Maiden’s special ability, Lunar Domain, further boosts all Lunar Reactions by applying a DMG bonus, including summoning more thundercloud strikes for Lunar-Charged reactions. Columbina is also capable of converting Electro-Charged, Bloom, and Hydro Crystallize reactions into Lunar Reactions, as well as revive fallen squad members.

Speaking of elemental reactions, new in this version is Lunar-Crystallize, a new reaction that’s triggered when Geo meets Hydro (under certain conditions). When triggered, Lunar-Crystallize summons three Moondrifts near enemies. When triggered three times, Moondrift Harmony gets activated, dealing Geo DMG to enemies caught in its radius.

Then there’s Zibai, an Adeptus from Liyue. Zibai is another 5-Star character, a Geo Sword wielder. Zibai can, through entering a special state where they can build up energy, unleash an Elemental Skill that deals Lunar-Crystallize DMG.

The longer the fight goes on, the more Lunar-Crystallize reactions are triggered, the higher (and more often) the damage of Zibai’s Elemental Skill becomes.

Luna 4 continues the Nod-Krai story arc, with a big confrontation with Il Dottore. This is the focus of the new Archon Quest, completing which will earn you a new outfit. There’s a gameplay element to that new chapter, too, with the reveal of Piramida, a new area north of the region. Piramida is the headquarters of the Lightkeepers.

The first phase of Luna 4’s Event Wishes will, unsurprisingly, feature Columbina. It’ll also include reruns of Ineffa. The second phase is when Zibai becomes available, alongside another newcomer: Illuga, a 4-Star, polearm-wielding Geo Lightkeeper. The second phase’s rerun will be Neuvillette, who’s also going to have a new outfit in the shop at a discount.

Version Luna 4 brings back the annual Lantern Rite event, taking place in the mainland of Liyue. The event features its own set of minigames with unique rewards, alongside new stories of the Adepti.

All around Liyue Harbor, you’ll be able to place Xiao Lanterns and inscribe them with messages for others to read. You’ll also earn some Fortune Coins from Auspicious Treasure Trees, which you can later exchange for gifts.

All players will receive 1,600 Primogems through the in-game mail. If you log in regularly, you can earn up to ten Intertwined Fates. Lantern Rite has a new outfit for Yaoyao, which is also where you have a chance to earn one 4-Star Liyue character for free.

Finally, you can look forward to the new Classic Mode in Miliastra Wonderland, which lets you invite select Teyvat characters to join you.

#4135. Sentinels complete 2027 VALORANT roster with British player keiko, reuniting him with brawk

Sentinels have signed Briton Georgio 'keiko' Sanassy from NRG as the final starter in their 2027 VCT Americas lineup. The move pairs him again with former NRG teammate brawk as Sentinels try to return to international events after missing them all in 2026.

The Sentinels lineup for 2027 now reads johnqt, brawk, OXY, canezerra and keiko. Zellsis rounds out the group as sixth man. He came back to the organisation on 7 November in that role and as a content creator. Contract lengths were not disclosed.

Sentinels called keiko ‘bloody brilliant’ in its announcement. Riot’s VALORANT Esports account then shared the news and described him as ‘the finishing touch’ on the lineup.

Sheep Esports first reported the move on 8 November, citing sources, and said keiko was expected to play controller. The same report had brawk on initiator and johnqt on sentinel.

The signing ends a rapid rebuild. OXY arrived on 2 November and brawk a day later. canezerra followed on 6 November. Four days after that, cortezia and Reduxx were released.

Only a few hours before joining Sentinels, brawk had ruled out staying at NRG.

keiko’s NRG spell ran from 12 November 2025 to 21 October 2026. He finished third at Masters Santiago 2026. He also placed third in both VCT Americas Stage 1 and Stage 2. At Champions 2026 he finished joint fifth to sixth.

That spell ended once Champions was over. NRG told him he would not be kept for the following year, keiko said on X on 21 October. He was then free to look for a new team as a restricted free agent.

Sentinels reached no international event in 2026. The team went out of that year’s Kickoff in the bottom four. It then missed the playoffs in both Stage 1 and Stage 2. Adding a player with that run of results is consistent with a side trying to close the gap quickly.

keiko was born on 12 September 2003. He grew up in and around London. He played competitive Fortnite before switching to VALORANT. His VALORANT career began at UK sides WYLDE, from May to August 2022, and BONK, from October to December 2022. He then joined Apeks from January to November 2023. That year he won the Challengers Rising Stars award. Team Liquid followed, from November 2023 to November 2025. His move to Sentinels places a British player at the centre of a rebuilt Americas contender.

The final piece has arrived, and he's bloody brilliant@Keikofps is officially a Sentinel pic.twitter.com/F5plGsyugj

— Sentinels (@Sentinels) November 16, 2026

The new lineup’s next test is the Americas Kickoff. Partner teams are guaranteed a place only at Kickoff. The Americas has eight partner teams, and all of them receive direct invitations to its event. Four further places go to non-partner teams.

The 2027 Kickoff events will be played in person in each international region. One of the non-partner places in the Americas will be decided by a Last Chance Qualifier in São Paulo on 17–18 December.

#4134. Caedrel and Dan Gaskin win for Britain at Esports Awards as Counter-Strike 2 takes top game

Britain's Marc 'Caedrel' Lamont and Dan Gaskin were among the winners at the 2026 Esports Awards in Miami, where Counter-Strike 2 was named game of the year and Team Vitality and BLAST also took industry honours. The results crown a strong Counter-Strike year eight days before the next CS2 Major begins in Singapore.

The 2026 Esports Awards honoured two British figures from the streaming and broadcast side of the scene. Caedrel is a League of Legends streamer and co-streamer. Gaskin works as a caster.

The ceremony took place on the evening of 17 November at the Adrienne Arsht Center for the Performing Arts of Miami-Dade County. It is the scene’s main end-of-season awards show. The event began in London in 2016.

At Worlds 2026, Caedrel was the top co-streamer for both hours watched and peak viewers, according to Esports Charts.

His co-stream success came in a softer year for the tournament overall. Worlds 2026 peaked at 3.98 million viewers, which was 41% lower than the previous year. Caedrel’s numbers show how much attention a single co-streamer can hold even when the event’s headline peak falls.

Gaskin was not the only caster honoured in Miami. The other broadcast honours went to Alex ‘Machine’ Richardson for Play-by-Play Caster of the Year, Iain Chambers for Host of the Year and Anthony ‘NAMELESS’ Wheeler for Analyst of the Year. iShowSpeed was named Streamer of the Year.

Counter-Strike featured prominently among the industry prizes. Vitality’s award as best organisation came alongside Esports PC Player of the Year for Mathieu ‘ZywOo’ Herbaut. OpTic Texas were named Esports Team of the Year.

BLAST, which stages many of its events in Europe, was named Esports Tournament Organiser of the Year.

Vitality’s results through the year back up their award. They beat Spirit to win IEM Rio 2026 on 19 April, giving them back-to-back ESL Grand Slam titles. ZywOo took his 31st career HLTV MVP award at that event.

"When I won this award in 2023, I never thanked my parents" 😅❤️

The PGL Major Singapore 2026 runs from 25 November to 13 December with 32 teams and a US$1,250,000 prize pool, The Kallang reported. The final stages will be played at the Singapore Indoor Stadium from 10 to 13 December.

#4133. Heartopia captures the hearts of Animal Crossing and The Sims fans to become the No.1 free download across 50 countries

Heartopia is officially the first big mobile launch of 2026, as the game grabs the attention of millions worldwide.

Heartopia, the new cosy life sim from XD Games, has officially arrived on mobile, right on schedule. If you’ve been keeping up with Heartopia news, you’re likely already aware that the game has pushed back its Steam release to an indeterminate point in 2026.

Doesn’t look like it mattered much, however, as this has already been a big launch on iOS and Android — it probably helps that PC players aren't being entirely left out of the fun, since the game is already available there via XD's own cross-device platform TapTap.

XD Games announced today that Heartopia has reached the top spot on the App Store’s downloads page for free games, and it managed to do so in more than 50 countries and regions worldwide.

The developer is celebratig by offering players a lot of free stuff. If you're feeling lucky, you’ll find new outfits and furniture in three gacha banners (Gilded Acorn Exhibitions): Polar Hymn, The Frostguard, and Coolplayism.

XD Games says you can expect regular updates to add more content, through Fashionwaves and Festivals. In fact, the first season - Winter Frost - is already penciled in for sometime in late January, and it’s going to add appropriately wintery activities like ice skating and snowman-building.

In February, a My Little Pony collaboration event will kick off, bringing new inspired outfits, and vehicles to the game.

Heartopia is a clever mix of Animal Crossing, and The Sims. It’s a free-to-play life sim where you can create your own character, dress them up, build a home for them (and decorate it), and go about town visiting and playing with other players’ characters.

The game’s main feature is the ability to take on a hobby, and seven of those are available at launch. You can dig deep into each hobby, either alone or with others, and there’s a progression track dedicated to each one.

Whether you’re among the millions who downloaded the game already, or you intend to so soon, we’ve got a set of helpful guides to get you started. You should check out how to unlock and upgrade hobbies in Heartopia first, before you get deep into finding all cooking recipes. And, of course, this wouldn’t be a big game launch without a bunch of Heartopia codes for some free stuff.
